name: Thoracic Spine Foam Roll
instructions: Lie on your back with a foam roller under your upper back and your hands behind your head.
Lift your hips slightly and roll slowly between your mid and upper back.
Pause on stiff spots and extend your upper back over the roller.
Do not roll onto your lower back or neck.
